Subject: Request: access log export windows and residency constraints

Marcus —

We're running an external compliance review and need to understand Redwood's capabilities around access/audit log exports for our EU tenant. Specifically:

- What are the default and maximum retention windows for access logs (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?
- Can you export logs for a single tenant scoped to a date range? Supported formats?
- Is cross-border transfer permitted for export (we are EU-based and may request delivery to our EU S3)?
- What is the expected turnaround for a bulk export (50GB) and for a priority/legal-hold request?
- Do you support PII redaction or field-level exclusions in exports?
- How do you handle deletion after export and proof of deletion (tombstones/manifest)?

We're looking to get answers and a sample export (small subset) by next week if possible. I've attached the audit intake template.

Hi all —

Quick answers from the export/retention side (short version):

Retention windows:
- Hosted (standard): default 90 days; configurable to 1 year for paid tiers; enterprise contracts can extend to 2 years with an SLA and additional storage fees.
- Dedicated: tenant-admin-configurable; we recommend a minimum 180 days for production workloads.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): retention fully customer-managed — Redwood does not retain copies unless explicitly configured in the control plane.

Export scoping & formats:
- Yes — we support tenant-scoped, project-scoped, and date-range exports.
- Formats: compressed JSONL (ndjson.gz), CSV (UTF-8, comma), and line-delimited protobuf-derived text when requested.
- Large exports are chunked (configurable chunk size, default 10GB) with a manifest file containing checksums.

Residency & transfer:
- We can deliver exports into cloud locations in the same region (EU) by presigned S3 PUT or by pushing to an SFTP endpoint you provide. Cross-border transfers are subject to the customer's residency settings in the tenant and any contractual clauses; for Finvero's EU tenant, we'll keep transfers inside EU unless you explicitly request otherwise.

PII/redaction & legal hold:
- We offer field-level exclusion and deterministic hashing for sensitive columns. For legal hold, we take a snapshot (immutable export) and flag the data to suspend automatic purge.

Deletion & proof:
- After export+hand-off, we can produce a deletion manifest + checksum-based tombstone evidence and a signed statement from Redwood operations. Deletion runs through our standard erase workflow (erase token, background deletion, notification).

I'll attach the export playbook and a short checklist. Karthik — SLA and turnaround microlines below?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Principal Product Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Folks —

A few operational notes to set expectations for Finvero: 

Turnaround / SLA:
- Standard bulk export (<=100GB): 48–72 hours from approved request + delivery window.
- Priority / legal-hold export: 24 hours with Premium support add-on (we can escalate to 8–12 hours for emergency legal requests with our on-call).
- Exports are rate-limited by current cluster load; Dedicated customers with reserved capacity get guaranteed throughput.

Redaction & filtering:
- We support: column exclusion, regex-based masking, deterministic SHA256 hashing of email addresses, and token-level redaction for message bodies.
- Redaction is applied at export time; original data remains in-situ until deletion request is completed.

Verification & chain-of-custody:
- Delivery includes per-chunk SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest. For higher assurance we can notarize the manifest (internal signature) and provide an S3 lifecycle policy snapshot.

Deletion workflow after export:
1) Customer confirms receipt and checksum match.
2) Customer opens a deletion request via our portal with reference to the manifest id.
3) Redwood schedules deletion job; we provide a deletion manifest and tombstone IDs once complete (typically completes within 72 hours).

Notes for Finvero: recommend requesting a scoped sample first, then a single bulk run with PII hashing enabled. For EU delivery, share a presigned PUT URL for eu-central-1 S3 or an EU SFTP endpoint.

Karthik
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
